# teams_group_policy_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a Teams policy to a group and manages its rank. Import assignments using `<group_id>/<policy_type>`.

Ranks are ordered per policy type and can be renumbered when other group assignments change; coordinate rank values and serialize changes for assignments of the same type.

Changes propagate to direct group members asynchronously, and nested groups do not inherit assignments. Direct user assignments take precedence. Groups with hidden membership are not supported, and Teams allows at most 64 group assignments per policy type.

Supported policy types: ApplicationAccessPolicy, CallingLineIdentity, ExternalAccessPolicy, OnlineAudioConferencingRoutingPolicy, OnlineVoiceRoutingPolicy, OnlineVoicemailPolicy, TeamsAppSetupPolicy, TeamsAudioConferencingPolicy, TeamsCallHoldPolicy, TeamsCallParkPolicy, TeamsCallingPolicy, TeamsChannelsPolicy, TeamsComplianceRecordingPolicy, TeamsCortanaPolicy, TeamsEmergencyCallingPolicy, TeamsEnhancedEncryptionPolicy, TeamsEventsPolicy, TeamsFeedbackPolicy, TeamsFilesPolicy, TeamsIPPhonePolicy, TeamsMediaLoggingPolicy, TeamsMeetingBrandingPolicy, TeamsMeetingBroadcastPolicy, TeamsMeetingPolicy, TeamsMeetingTemplatePermissionPolicy, TeamsMessagingPolicy, TeamsMobilityPolicy, TeamsRoomVideoTeleConferencingPolicy, TeamsSharedCallingRoutingPolicy, TeamsShiftsPolicy, TeamsUpdateManagementPolicy, TeamsVdiPolicy, TeamsVideoInteropServicePolicy, TeamsVirtualAppointmentsPolicy, TenantDialPlan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "teams_group_policy_assignment" "meeting" {
  group_id    = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  policy_type = "TeamsMeetingPolicy"
  policy_name = "RetailManagers"
  rank        = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Entra group object ID. Changing this forces replacement.
- `policy_name` (String) Name of the Teams policy instance to assign.
- `policy_type` (String) Teams policy type. Changing this forces replacement. The schema description lists supported values.
- `rank` (Number) Rank among assignments of the same policy type; 1 has highest priority.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Assignment identifier in <group_id>/<policy_type> format.
